name: directed degree-preserving edge switching with mutual-degree preservation

ensemble.switchProposal: choose two single directed edges uniformly and swap their targets

execution.prng: sfc32 seeded independently per trial from SHA-256(seed + ':' + trialIndex)
execution.ordering: trial index ascending; catalog order frozen
execution.implementationBoundary: deterministic reimplementation of the published ensemble and switch policy; not a byte-for-byte replay of mfinder's wall-clock-seeded ran2 stream

statistics.nullMean: arithmetic mean across all trials, including zero counts
statistics.nullStandardDeviation: sample standard deviation with denominator trials - 1, matching mfinder 1.2 result code
statistics.zScore: (observed - nullMean) / nullStandardDeviation; null when deviation is zero
statistics.foldEnrichment: observed / nullMean; null when nullMean is zero
statistics.relativeEnrichment: (observed - nullMean) / nullMean; null when nullMean is zero
statistics.ranking: descending finite Z-score, then canonical ID; undefined Z-scores follow finite scores
